experiment: Ω change detection and memory ablation
status: JavaScript reference simulation executed in this session; committed Python script not executed here.
key_finding: The confidence/change detector raised alarms in 99% of trials but on average about 49 steps before the actual shift; noisy initial feedback caused false alarms. Its accuracy was worse than fixed routing. This is a negative result for the current detector.
limitations: Reference simulation is JavaScript, not execution of committed Python.
The detector is an intentionally simple heuristic and is not validated.
No claims about emergence, general intelligence, or consciousness.
